description: Fork of exp567 (E=96, 1.4768 @ 103.02M / 475 Mbits/tok). THREE coupled changes: (1) residual_lut REMOVED from every LUTBlock — no D-stream, no x_resid accumulator. (2) Linear unembedder REMOVED (12.58M deleted). (3) Tied dot head: logits = LayerNorm(E)(x_lut) @ tok_emb_E.T. residual_dim field still in config but no module references D anymore. Predicted params ~71.5M (-31.5M, -31%); bandwidth ~163 Mbits/tok (-66% vs exp567, 22% of vanilla-untied's 742). 'How far can pure E-stream + tied dot go' — bound on minimal-arch quality. Expected loss 1.54-1.60 range based on E=64 tied baselines (exp560 1.6283, exp561 1.6171) scaled up by E=64->96 widening (-0.02 to -0.04). Adjudication: <1.55 = stunning bandwidth-quality point worth iterating on; 1.55-1.60 = residual_lut + Linear head were pulling 70-100 mb; >1.60 = D-stream was load-bearing, need a thinner residual_lut. Refs: exp567 1.4768 (parent), exp560 1.6283 (tied E=64), vanilla-untied exp476 1.4143 / 742 Mbits.
